A '''cantina''' was located in the [[Outsider Citadel/Legends|Outsider Citadel]] on the planet [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]]. It was often frequented by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. Seeking information on [[Ephant Mon/Legends|who]] was smuggling [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bikes]] into the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] went there looking for his friend [[Ydde]] and found him drinking there. An [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] sign over the entrance said "BAR".<ref name="SW98" />
